title: Donor
description: One row per donor core in the SAHA consortium. These slides are tissue microarrays, so a core -- not a slide -- is the unit of donor identity. Includes cohort members awaiting acquisition, flagged by in_release.

donor_core.description: Donor core label, `<SLIDE>_<CORE>` (e.g. COL_A1_5). Joins to obs `donor_core` in the released objects and to SampleID in Table 1 of the manuscript. snake_case throughout.

donor_patient.description: Grouping key where two cores are known to be the same person. Populated for the PDAC slide only (28 cores from 14 KRAS-typed patients); cores are never collapsed.

slide_id.description: Slide the core sits on (e.g. PANC_A1).

organ.description: Organ of tissue origin for this core.

condition.description: Gross tissue condition for this core.

age.description: Controlled tier only; absent from the open donors.parquet. Donor age in years at time of tissue collection.

age_group.description: Registered tier; absent from the open donors.parquet. Broad age category for access-tier reporting.

sex.description: Registered tier; absent from the open donors.parquet. Biological sex (M/F/unknown).

ethnicity.description: Registered tier; absent from the open donors.parquet. Self-reported ethnicity using NIH standard categories.

in_release.description: Whether any released object carries cells from this core. False for cohort members whose block is held on a slide but which no acquisition covers yet -- they are kept so the table describes the cohort, not just the subset with data.

status_note.description: Why a core has no released data yet (block not acquired, or outside the acquired fields of view). Null for released cores.
